limitations: Original map acquisition dates and identifiers are not completely recoverable from the published snapshot.
Original Blender files and the full source-data workset are not included. Export repackages the published pack; it does not recreate geometry.
Artistic reconstruction and approximate road widths, smoothing, scenery and elevations are unsuitable for navigation, surveying or safety decisions.
No browser-rendering, gameplay or frame-rate signoff is implied by structural checks.
